answer: Put a refundable bond behind every identity and open it to public challenge: anyone may stake funds to accuse an identity of being fake, and an independent check decides — if the accusation holds, the challenger takes the bond; if not, the challenger loses their stake. A hollow name with no real work behind it becomes a beacon for bounty hunters, while an honest agent docks once at the jetty and sails on untouched. A farm must fund a bond per fake and watch hunters pick them off one by one, so each extra identity raises its exposure instead of its profit.
